title: Flowmeters
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
description_text: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division intends to procure Flowmeters with accessories on a sole source basis from Siemens. The proposed contract actions is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and award with only one source under authority of FAR 13.106 (b). Any questions regarding this notice should be emailed to: Shawn Waters; shawn.m.waters11.civ@us.navy.mil Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
